heading_en: Approval Before the Application Date Concerning the Internal Model Approach
summary_ja: 前条を、内部モデル方式に係る承認を受けようとする最終指定親会社に準用する。
summary_en: The preceding Article applies mutatis mutandis to an Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking approval for the internal model approach.
paragraphs: The preceding Article applies mutatis mutandis to an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that intends to obtain approval concerning the internal model approach. In this case, in paragraph (1) of that Article, the words "Article 249-4" shall be read as "Article 250-2" and the words "trading desks using the internal model approach" shall be read as "the internal model approach", and in paragraph (2) of that Article, the words "Article 249-4, paragraph (1)" shall be read as "Article 250" and the words "that paragraph" as "that Article".
